summary: KeyCorp filed an 8-K reporting an update to its Medium-Term Note Program, authorizing the issuance of Senior Medium-Term Notes, Series U, and Subordinated Medium-Term Notes, Series V, under existing indentures with Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas as trustee. The Notes are registered under an S-3 shelf (File No. 333-296536) filed June 5, 2026. No specific pricing, amount, maturity, or other economic terms are disclosed. This is a routine shelf takedown update and not a special situation event.
